entry.title: Rag & Bones RVA, October 22
entry.content:
From Rag & Bones RVA



🦃💣🚲Give Cranks!🚲💣🦃

⚪Cranksgiving is an all-day city-wide cycling extravaganza where teams compete to stock the RVA Community Fridges on the Saturday before Thanksgiving.

⚪On November 21st, 12pm at Skuffletown Park, RVA's finest street racing cyclists (that's you!) gather as many prepacked bags of Thanksgiving staples donated by the community as possible.

⚪Race to stock the fridges and complete a host of fun challenges, including a mini track race by team Alléz Gattí!

⚪ Cranksgiving is a day on your bike to encourage community service and well-being, and win fun prizes like PNX Bags and more!

⚪The alley cat will end at 5pm at Rag & Bones Bicycle Cooperative, where participants can partake in soup and grilled cheese, and music before the final award ceremony.

⚪Registration is $5 or 1 lb of food in a plastic bag - NOTAFLAF
Registration fee will be waived for folks who donated to the pre-race food drive

⚪Want to contribute to the pre-race food drive? Make a contribution here: https://venmo.com/code?user_id=1875715758751744703&created=1792703404

🦃💣🚲Give Cranks🚲💣🦃
